top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, unbroken discovery chain from proglucagon processing and the incretin effect through the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and its human physiology to receptor agonists with independently confirmed glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The Drucker, Holst and Mojsov allocation fits the three-person cap and the discovery-level scope of the citation. The Mojsov versus Habener priority question is unresolved from the supplied record, but it affects the name list more than the merit, and it is not strong enough to prefer no award.
